events.title: FAAN proposes 25-day closure of Owerri airport runway for repairs
events.summary:
The airport authority says the repairs will address potholes and surface cracks worsened by heavy rainfall, while plans also include extending the runway to accommodate larger aircraft.

events.title: ‘Nkoko Nketenkete’ boosts local poultry production from 4.6% to 22% in one year – Agric Minister
events.summary: The government’s Nkoko Nketenkete programme has helped increase Ghana’s domestic poultry production from 4.6% to 22% as of May 2026, Minister for Food and Agriculture Eric Opoku has said.
